name: auto-agent-team
description: Coordinate native Codex subagents by default and show DSH-style team state, fixed main tasks, dynamic follow-up work, verification, review, and backup execution in a live dashboard.

interface.shortDescription: Native Codex agents by default with a live team dashboard
interface.longDescription: Adds a local Agent Team MCP runtime and DSH-style dashboard for members, native Codex subagents, fixed main-task progress, dynamic follow-up tasks, dependencies, verification, and review. Native Codex subagents are the default execution path for suitable independent work; sequential single-context execution is backup only after concrete native-spawn unavailability or failure.
defaultPrompt: Build this project with native Codex agents and show the team dashboard.
Split useful independent work across native Codex agents, verify it, and review it.
Open the Auto Agent Team dashboard for this workspace.
